messages.subject: stat_qq and geom_text
parts:
I am having trouble adding labels to the following plot in ggplot
0.8.9:
> library(ggplot2)
> ggplot(mpg, aes(sample = cty, label = model)) + stat_qq() + facet_wrap(~ year)

Using geom_text() returns an error:
> ggplot(mpg, aes(sample = cty, label = model)) + stat_qq() + facet_wrap(~ year) + geom_text()
Error: geom_text requires the following missing aesthetics: x, y

Is there an easy way to fix this problem?
Many thanks,
Dario
